src.IFS: ECMWF IFS HRES 0.25 deg (ECMWF open data)
src.AIFS: ECMWF AIFS Single 0.25 deg (ECMWF open data)
src.ICON: DWD ICON global ~13 km native grid (DWD open data), days 1-7
src.ARPEGE: Meteo-France ARPEGE 0.25 deg (Meteo-France open data), days 1-4

note: Value = maximum of the model grid-point values inside each district (mm per 24 h). models: Day 1..10 of this run; shift: the 24-h windows of Day 1..10 of the next run (IC + 12 h).
